property.name: optionsInput
property.description-key: The multi-select choice column this control replaces. Place this control directly on that column.

property.name: hideHiddenOptions
property.description-key: Hide options marked as hidden in the choice. Options that are already selected are always shown.

property.name: sortBy
property.description-key: Order of the selected values and the options list

value.name: Value
value.description-key: Sort by the integer value of the options (default)

value.name: Text
value.description-key: Sort alphabetically by the option label, in the user language

value.name: Autofit
value.description-key: Arrange the selected values to fit into as few lines as possible, repacking when the field is resized. The drop-down list keeps value order

property.name: searchDescriptions
property.description-key: When enabled, typing in the search box also matches the description of each choice option, not only its label

property.name: placeholderText
property.description-key: Search box placeholder, shown to the right of the selected options.

property.name: selectedDisplayMode
property.description-key: How the selected options are shown in the field

value.name: Pills
value.description-key: Each selected option is shown as a colored pill with a remove button (default)

value.name: Text
value.description-key: Selected options are shown as a comma-separated list of icons and labels

property.name: componentHeight
property.description-key: Minimum height of the field. The field grows as selected options wrap onto more lines.

value.name: Tall
value.description-key: Standard height field

value.name: Short
value.description-key: Compact height field

property.name: selectionShape
property.description-key: Corner shape of each selected option, in both the Pills and Text display

value.name: Square
value.description-key: Sharp corners

value.name: Rounded
value.description-key: Slightly rounded corners (default)

value.name: Round
value.description-key: Fully rounded ends

property.name: makeFontBold
property.description-key: Display the selected option labels in bold font weight

property.name: useExternalValueForIcon
property.description-key: When enabled, the External Value of each choice option is used as its icon. Accepts an MDL2 icon name (browse at https://www.flicon.io) or the name of a square image web resource, e.g. lops_MyLogo.png. Semicolon-separate several values (lops_Logo.png;Tag) to try them in order - the first one that renders wins. Options without a usable External Value fall back to Fixed Icon Name.

property.name: iconFixedName
property.description-key: Optional: an MDL2 icon name or image web resource name shown for every option whose External Value produced no icon - or for every option, if Use external value for icon is off. Semicolon-separate several values to try them in order. When nothing resolves, a dot in the choice color is shown instead.

property.name: iconColorMode
property.description-key: How MDL2 icon glyphs are colored: automatic contrast, a fixed color, the choice option own color (default), or a faded version of it. Image web resources are never recolored.

value.name: Auto
value.description-key: Icon color matches the text color for contrast

value.name: CustomColor
value.description-key: Use the Icon color property

value.name: ChoiceColor
value.description-key: Use the option own configured color (default)

value.name: CustomColorFaded
value.description-key: Use a lighter, faded version of the option own configured color

property.name: iconColor
property.description-key: Icon color when Icon color mode is Fixed color (hex, e.g. #255BA4)

property.name: selectionBackgroundMode
property.description-key: Whether the background behind each selected option (Pills and Text display) uses a custom color, the choice option own color, or a faded version of it

value.name: CustomColor
value.description-key: Use the Selection color property

value.name: ChoiceColor
value.description-key: Use the option own configured color

value.name: CustomColorFaded
value.description-key: Use a lighter, faded version of the option own configured color (default)

property.name: selectionColor
property.description-key: Background color behind each selected option (Pills and Text display) when Selection background mode is Custom color, and the fallback for options without a color (hex, e.g. #EDF3FB)

property.name: pillBorderMode
property.description-key: Pills display only: whether each pill shows a border, and whether it uses a custom color or the choice option own color. Text display never shows a border.

value.name: Off
value.description-key: No border

value.name: CustomColor
value.description-key: Use the Pill border color property

value.name: ChoiceColor
value.description-key: Use the option own configured color (default)

value.name: CustomColorFaded
value.description-key: Use a lighter, faded version of the option own configured color

property.name: pillBorderColor
property.description-key: Pills display only: border color when Pill border mode is Custom color, and the fallback for options without a color (hex, e.g. #255BA4)

property.name: hoverColor
property.description-key: Background of an option in the drop-down list while hovered or keyboard-highlighted (hex, e.g. #F3F2F1)

property.name: listSelectedColor
property.description-key: Background of an already selected option in the drop-down list (hex, e.g. #EDF3FB)
